+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def moderate_text(text: str, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("text must be a string")
+    if not text.strip():
+        raise ValueError("text must not be empty")
+
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {"input": text}
+    if model:
+        payload["model"] = model
+    else:
+        payload["model"] = OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    results = data.get("results") or []
+    if not results:
+        return {
+            "flagged": False,
+            "categories": {},
+            "category_scores": {},
+            "raw": data,
+        }
+
+    result = results[0]
+    return {
+        "flagged": bool(result.get("flagged", False)),
+        "categories": dict(result.get("categories") or {}),
+        "category_scores": dict(result.get("category_scores") or {}),
+        "raw": data,
+    }
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import json
+    import sys
+
+    text = sys.stdin.read()
+    output = moderate_text(text)
+    print(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
*** End Patch
